title: Senior Data Quality Assurance Specialist
description:
The Senior Data Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of enterprise data assets, reporting solutions, and data integration processes.

This role serves as the primary quality assurance resource for Power BI reporting, SQL\-based data warehouses, ETL processes, and data integrations from internal and third\-party systems.

The Senior Data QA Specialist will perform comprehensive validation of data pipelines, reports, dashboards, and database objects while proactively identifying and resolving data discrepancies across multiple systems.

The position works closely with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity throughout the data lifecycle.

Additionally, this role supports production operations through troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect management, and resolution of data\-related issues impacting business reporting and analytics.

This position will report to the Director — Enterprise Data and BI

title: Sr. QA Engineer
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Exp: \-4 TO 5 Years**

Manual Testing: Functional Testing, Regression Testing, Smoke/Sanity Testing, Integration Testing, System Testing, Exploratory Testing.  
Test Documentation: Test Scenario, Test Case, Test Data, RTM, Test Summary Report, Defect Reports.  
Defect Management: Defect identification, logging, severity/priority classification, defect lifecycle, retesting \& closure.  
Automation Testing: Selenium / Playwright / Cypress; automation framework development and maintenance.  
Frameworks: Page Object Model (POM).  
API Testing: Postman, REST API testing.  
Database Testing: SQL queries, CRUD operations.  
Performance Testing Basic/Intermediate knowledge of JMeter, load testing, stress testing, response\-time analysis.  
Version Control: Git, GitLab/GitHub, branching, merge, commit, pull/merge requests.  
Bug Tracking: Jira or similar tools.  
Agile/Scrum : Sprint planning, daily stand\-up, backlog, refinement, review, retrospective.  
Requirement Analysis: Understanding BRD/FRD/URS, identifying testable requirements, clarification of gaps.  
Test Strategy: Test planning, estimation, test approach, risk\-based testing.

Release Testing: Build verification, release validation, regression testing, production verification.  
Mobile Testing: Basic Android/iOS testing and responsive testing.  
Communication: Client communication, requirement clarification, defect discussion and status reporting.  
Provide regular status updates to stakeholders.  
Take ownership of QA deliverables, timelines, and project quality without continuous supervision.
